item.title: Safety issues for cyclist using the segregated cycle path heading south east down St Pancras Way, at the junction with Camden Road, 22nd October
item.description:
I think this junction is dangerous for cyclists because the segregated cycle lane means that cyclists tend to be on the left when approaching the traffic lights, with most going straight on and continuing down St Pancras Way. However, cars and motorbikes can turn left into Camden Road, which creates a risk of motor vehicles turning left into bicycles which are going straight on.
Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): 80, St. Pancras Way, Kentish Town, Greater London
